create_BasicPointCloud: create a BasicPointCloud dataclass with points, colors, and normals numpy arrays
build_geom_transform_points: build a function to transform 3D points using a homogeneous transformation matrix
build_getWorld2View: build a 4x4 world-to-view matrix from rotation matrix and translation vector

build_fov2focal: build a function to convert field of view angle to focal length in pixels
